tasks.title: Add MySQL/MariaDB backend with hand-written queries and testcontainers integration
tasks.description: New internal/store/mysql/{db,conn,entity_state_repo,signal_repo,schema.sql,integration_test}.go. Register 'mysql' AND 'mariadb' schemes (shared wire protocol + dialect). Translate ?namespace= into a MySQL database name (CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS <ns>; USE <ns>) — MySQL has no schemas. ParseDSN converts the URL form to libmysql DSN (user:pw@tcp(host:port)/db?parseTime=true) since the driver doesn't speak URLs natively. Hand-write queries to match the Postgres backend's surface (Save batch, ListByScope, ListByEntity, DeleteOlderThan, Count, ListScopes). Driver: github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql. Integration test mirrors Mnemos's pattern: testcontainers-go spins MariaDB on demand; gated behind a build tag or env var so unit tests stay fast in non-Docker environments.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Anomaly
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Anomaly. Cross-entity dual of Recurrence. For each entity's most recent state,
cosine-compare to peers' most recent states; emit when highest peer similarity
is below AnomalyMaxSimilarity. Strength = 1 - max_similarity. Evidence kind
peer_distance, one per peer.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Seasonality
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Seasonality. Pearson autocorrelation at lags [MinPeriod, n/2]. Emit when largest peak exceeds
SeasonalityMinAutocorr. Strength = peak value; metrics carry the period (lag).
Evidence kind autocorrelation_peak.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Stall
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Stall. Normalised stddev of outcomes below StallMaxStdDev over at least StallMinPoints.
Strength reflects flatness (1 - normalised_stddev / threshold). Evidence kind
variance_window.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Spike / Drop
tasks.description:

carry z, baseline mean / stddev. Evidence kind baseline_deviation.

tasks.title: Add client.Signals().Stream(ctx) for SSE consumers
tasks.description: Extend the Go SDK with a streaming method that opens GET /v1/signals/stream, parses the SSE event:signal/data:<json> framing, and pushes decoded client.Signal values onto a returned channel. Close the channel on ctx cancellation, EOF, or unrecoverable error. Honour Scope (required) and Pattern filters via the existing builder. Reuse the auth/user-agent already configured on the client. Test against httptest.Server emitting canned SSE frames including a heartbeat comment, multi-line data, and graceful close. Update README reading-signals section with a Stream() example.

tasks.title: SSE endpoint + background detection scheduler in serve
tasks.description:
internal/notify/sse.go: SSE.Notify broadcasts to subscribed clients via per-client buffered channel; drops slow consumers (channel send select default). SSE.Subscribe returns a channel + cancel; Unsubscribe cleans up. internal/api adds GET /v1/signals/stream handler: parses scope_id (required) + optional pattern filter, sets Content-Type text/event-stream + Cache-Control no-cache + Connection keep-alive, writes `event: signal
data: <SignalDTO JSON>

` per matching signal until client disconnects. internal/pipeline/scheduler.go: Scheduler.Run loops on a ticker, enumerates scopes via new EntityStateRepository.ListScopes(ctx), runs Engine.Detect over each scope's states, saves emitted signals through the wrapped repo (so Notifier fires). Add ListScopes to ports and all three store backends (memory/sqlite/postgres). Add CHRONOS_DETECTION_INTERVAL env var (default 0 = scheduler off). cmd/chronos/serve.go starts the Scheduler when interval > 0. Tests cover SSE delivery, slow-consumer drop, scheduler tick path.

tasks.title: Triage and reduce the nox baseline
tasks.description: The committed nox baseline silences 381 findings. Most are likely Action SHA pinning (IAC-013), email-in-config (DATA-001), and container image digest pinning (CONT-001) — actionable. Goal: fix the easy ones in source, suppress documented-intent ones, re-baseline at the end. Categorize by RuleID first, then drive each rule to either zero or a documented suppression. Reducing the baseline shrinks the trust gap between 'no new findings' and 'no findings'.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Correlation
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Correlation. Pairwise Pearson on aligned outcome series within a scope. One signal per pair,
deterministically owned by the lex-smaller series ID; the other appears as evidence.
Strength = |r|; metrics carry r and direction. Evidence kind pair_correlation.
Cost is O(N²) in series count per scope.

tasks.title: Webhook notifier with HMAC and best-effort retry
tasks.description: internal/notify/webhook.go: WebhookNotifier(URLs, Secret, Timeout, Retries). On Notify, marshal api.SignalDTO, HMAC-SHA256 sign, POST to each URL with X-Chronos-Signature: sha256=<hex>, X-Chronos-Delivery: <uuid>, X-Chronos-Event: signal.detected. Best-effort: configurable retries (default 1) on 5xx with 1s linear backoff; no retry on 2xx or 4xx. Per-URL goroutine. Increment observability.Metrics counter on success/failure. Add CHRONOS_WEBHOOK_URLS / CHRONOS_WEBHOOK_SECRET / CHRONOS_WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT / CHRONOS_WEBHOOK_RETRIES env vars to config. Wire into both cmd/chronos/compute.go and cmd/chronos/serve.go (wrap signals repo with NotifyingSignalRepository(WebhookNotifier(...))). Tests use httptest.Server to verify signature, headers, retry behaviour, multi-URL fan-out.

tasks.title: Refactor store to scheme-dispatched registry with DSN + namespace
tasks.description: Mirror Mnemos's ADR 0001 contract. Replace internal/store/store.go's switch in Open with a Register(scheme, OpenFunc) registry; have memory/sqlite/postgres providers self-register in init(). Introduce DSN-as-URL with ?namespace= query param (default 'chronos', validated ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$). Each provider translates namespace into its native isolation: memory key prefix, sqlite distinct file (or single-file passthrough — Chronos isn't multi-tenant so default the same as Mnemos), postgres CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS + SET search_path. Add CHRONOS_DB_DSN env var as the new primary; keep CHRONOS_DB_TYPE+CHRONOS_DB_CONN as legacy mapped internally to the new DSN form so operators don't break. Update cmd/chronos/{compute,serve}.go to use the new entry point. Update internal/store/store.go's Conn shape (EntityStateRepository + SignalRepository — unchanged from before). Tests must include round-trip: legacy env-var → DSN → provider; explicit DSN with namespace; missing scheme rejection; unknown scheme rejection.

tasks.title: Add libSQL provider reusing SQLite repositories
tasks.description: internal/store/libsql/libsql.go registers the 'libsql' scheme and reuses internal/store/sqlite/{conn,entity_state_repo,signal_repo}.go via constructor functions exported from sqlite. The libsql provider parses the DSN, translates libsql:// URLs into the form tursodatabase/libsql-client-go expects (libsql:// for remote, file: for local-file paths), opens via database/sql with driver name 'libsql', applies the embedded SQLite migration (libSQL is wire-compatible with SQLite at the SQL level), and returns the Conn. ?namespace= is accepted but ignored — each remote libSQL DB is already a tenant boundary, matching Mnemos's posture. Pure-Go driver keeps CGO_ENABLED=0. Tests cover DSN translation (remote vs file) and provider registration.

tasks.title: Implement Detector — Recurrence
tasks.description:
Implement the feature: Detector — Recurrence. For each entity's most recent state, look at strictly historical states of
OTHER entities in the same scope. Cosine similarity ≥ threshold counts as a
similar peer. Strength = avg(peer similarity). Confidence = strength × min(samples/5, 1).
Evidence kind similar_state with metrics["outcome_diff"] = peer.outcome - subject.outcome.

tasks.title: Reduce nox baseline by gitignoring Roady journal files
tasks.description: 1167 of 1316 baseline entries (89%) come from .roady/events.jsonl - an append-only transition journal whose UUIDs trip secret-detection heuristics. usage.json adds another ~10. Gitignore both files: state.json (canonical state), spec.yaml, spec.lock.json, plan.json, and policy.yaml stay tracked, so durable project state still persists across clones; events.jsonl becomes per-clone bookkeeping. Re-baseline nox; expected drop from ~1316 to ~150.

tasks.title: Document stable evidence kinds and metrics keys as wire contract
tasks.description: Detector emissions use stable string keys (similar_state, regression_summary, baseline_deviation, variance_window, peer_distance, autocorrelation_peak, pair_correlation) and metric names (outcome_diff, slope, intercept, r2, n, z, baseline_mean, baseline_stddev, observed_outcome, normalised_stddev, max_peer_similarity, peer_count, period, autocorrelation, r, abs_r, direction, avg_similarity, sample_size, avg_outcome_diff, mean, window).
